quotes.author: TripAdvisor
quotes.text: 204fionas Chesterfield, United Kingdom Review from Nov 5, 2024 Grand Canyon West Rim Helicopter Dream Tour Meadview AZ Ranch Amazing experience Absolutely amazing, no photograph can do it justice. The set up at the ranch before you leave is superb, everyone was so friendly . We had chance to take photos before you take your trip. Once you are on board, the pilot explains everything to you. Then it’s take off .. I surfer with travel sickness but it was a very smooth flight. The views of the Grand Canyon are breathtaking and so worth the trip. I would certainly do it again. A first class trip. .

quotes.author: Goggle
quotes.text: For our first flight over the Grand Canyon, we had an unforgettable time with Linda at the reception and Tom at the controls of the helicopter! Their kindness is incredible! Regarding the flight, Tom was able to take into account the fact that we had no flying experience and he piloted the aircraft in a pleasant and safe manner. His explanations and his good humor quickly relaxed us and the view during the flight is breathtaking! Thank you to them and we recommend them to anyone who wants to be amazed while being perfectly welcomed!

quotes.author: Goggle
quotes.text: Thank you for a great flight over the Grand Canyon! If you're in Vegas, Wild West Helicopters is an absolute must. Linda and Tom are lovely, caring, and professional. They welcome you with great attention, adapt to each guest, and do everything to ensure you're in the best possible conditions. It's nothing like the big companies where you're treated like just another number! The flight over the Grand Canyon was safe, magical, and simply incredible. I thank them very much. Don't hesitate to contact them; they're truly the best.

You MUST take a flight with Wild West Helicopters! We were so lucky to have stopped by. The folks who work there are simply awesome. We've been on many helicopter tours and this was simply unbelievable. Since this is a smaller operation, they treat you like people instead of numbers or "just another customer." Amazing ambiance. Very cozy and fantastic hospitality. This was the highlight of our trip.
